mission.name: Dragonfire (Human 3/3)
mission.briefing: The dragon roosts. Hold the keep against three war-horns of orcs, then storm their fortress with everything you have.
mission.objective: Survive the sieges, then destroy the orc fortress.

ops.text: Abbott: three war-horns march on us. Man the towers, my son.
Survive the sieges, then destroy the orc fortress.
Your keep has fallen. The campaign is lost.
The enemy is wiped from these lands. Victory!
The last war-horn! Their reserve commits.
